method: 只读 text/ 素读，未开 md。抬头：Thursday, July 24, 2053 (Clare is 82, Henry is 43, Beck is 77)。本章叙述者是 Beck（第一人称），不是 Alba。

facts.fact: 抬头：2053 年 7 月 24 日星期四；Clare 82 岁、Henry 43 岁、Beck 77 岁。叙述者 Beck：他们住在密歇根上半岛（Upper Peninsula of Michigan）的湖畔小屋；两人都是早起的，但 Clare 随天亮就起，Beck 通常晚一个小时；Clare 喜欢早饭前有一段独处时间。
facts.quote: Beck: Clare and I are both early birds, in these long light summer days at our lake house in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, but she gets up with the dawn and I usually wake about an hour later. She likes to have a little alone time before breakfast.
facts.anchor: Beck: Clare and I are both early birds

facts.fact: 早晨两人都不爱说话：一起坐在餐厅长桌边，看湖上的鸭子和潜鸟（ducks and loons），吃燕麦粥（oatmeal）。Clare 膝上常放速写本，可能画她做的梦，或给自己写清单和笔记；Beck 喜欢做填字游戏。他们的早晨很平静。
facts.quote: Neither of us are chatty people in the morning. We sit together at the long table in the dining room, watch the ducks and loons on the lake, and eat our oatmeal. Sometimes Clare has a sketchbook in her lap; she might draw a dream she had, or write lists or notes to herself. I like to do crosswords.
facts.anchor: Neither of us are chatty people in the morning

facts.fact: 这天早上 Beck 在床上多赖了一会儿，觉得会是很热的一天，想再享受几分钟卧室的凉意；想着今天适合游泳。他看见泳衣挂在浴缸上方——昨夜他们把船划到湖上，喝 pinot grigio、唱老 Beyoncé 的歌（他还记得很多歌词），然后下水泡了一会儿。湖水如今很暖，蚊子几乎没了，他觉得这既可怕又方便。
facts.quote: This morning I was dozing in bed a little longer than usual. I could feel that the day was going to be very hot, and I wanted to put it off for a few more minutes and just lie there and savor the cool of the bedroom.
facts.anchor: This morning I was dozing in bed a little longer than usual

facts.fact: 他听见屋里响动：门吱呀、椅子刮地板、急促的脚步，然后没了声。他悄悄起床，戴上眼镜、披上睡袍，沿黑走廊走到阳光刺眼的餐厅。门开着，但他没进去。
facts.quote: As I lay there dozing I heard noises in the house: a door creaking, a chair scraping the floor, then quick footsteps, then nothing. I got up quietly, put on my glasses and my robe and went down the dark hall to the brilliantly sunny dining room.
facts.anchor: As I lay there dozing I heard noises in the house

facts.fact: 餐厅里有个男人和 Clare 在一起，背对 Beck：白发，但看得出不是老人；高、瘦、赤身裸体。Beck 知道他是谁——多年前见过他一次。他和 Clare 默默相拥。Clare 看见了 Beck，Beck 只是笑了笑，退回走廊，穿过屋子、从大门出去，像来时一样安静。他走到湖岸，此刻站在自家地界边缘望着水面，等 Clare。
facts.quote: There was a man with Clare, standing with his back to me, a white-haired man, but I could see that he was not an old man. He was tall and thin and quite naked; of course I knew who he was. I’d seen him once before, years ago. He and Clare stood embracing silently.
facts.anchor: There was a man with Clare, standing with his back to me

facts.fact: Beck 在心里对 Henry 说话：你陪了她很久，我陪她更久，我们之间她过了有趣的一生。「I’m sorry you died so young.」他想知道自己若活着会怎样，说「I’ll never know you, nor you me」，觉得两人会彼此喜欢；希望 Alba 若告诉过 Henry「who I really am」，Henry 能大度地为 Clare 高兴。他说爱在这世上稀缺，他们三个在爱上是幸运的；Henry 每天都在场，但他学会了不去介意。此刻也不介意 Henry 在这里，因为 Clare 等了他很久，而这是告别。他意外地感到悲伤——原以为会是如释重负。
facts.quote: Well, I say to Henry in my head, you were with her for a long time and I have been with her for a longer time and between us she’s had an interesting life. I’m sorry you died so young.
facts.anchor: Well, I say to Henry in my head

facts.fact: 他说 Clare 半辈子都在盼这一天；他为 Henry 将永远消失而难过：「How strange, to miss someone I never knew.」后来 Clare 出现，慢慢走过来站到他身边，小心地握住他的手——两人都有关节炎。对话：「He finally came, then?」「He did.」「Was it what you thought it’d be like?」「Better, but I’d hoped he would stay longer.」「I’m sure he wished he could.」「Did you ask him all your questions?」「No.」「Not one?」「I just let him go.」
facts.quote: “He finally came, then?” I say. “He did,” Clare says.
facts.anchor: Eventually Clare appears, walking slowly until she is standing beside me

facts.fact: 两人往回走，Clare 情绪低落。进门之前 Beck 问她「Are you all right?」，她说「It really did finally happen. He came.」Beck 说「I’m glad for you. So glad.」Clare 哭起来，两人相拥、随她的抽泣一起发抖。Beck 说「He’s still there, in the past, he’s never gone, Clare.」Clare 答「I know. I know. That’s what makes it hard.」她不好意思地笑说自己一团糟、该进屋了；Beck 递纸巾，她擤了鼻子，两人走进湖畔小屋——「our house」。Clare 说「Let’s have some breakfast. It’s going to be a beautiful day.」
facts.quote: “It really did finally happen. He came.”
facts.anchor: We stand there for a while and then I say, “Shall we walk back to the house?”

turnpoint: 本章转折点＝Henry 最后一次现身（白发、赤身、不是老人）而 Clare 一个问题都没问就放他走（I just let him go）；已进第 5、7 条，无需补。
